dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent O-shaped and C-shaped structures exhibit high-contrast light-grey perimeters with jagged, irregular boundaries. The pixel gradient transitions sharply from dark-grey/blue interior centers and interstitial spaces to high-intensity white/light-grey perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid-core pixel clusters; most features maintain an internal gradient. Isolated, high-intensity white micro-blobs are visible primarily along the lower lateral-ventral transition boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest and most defined macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, high-saturation orange-red linear mark is visible on the dorsal surface of the posterior flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: Labyrinthine interlocking of multiple annuli along the mid-lateral flank creates a continuous, complex mesh-like texture rather than discrete isolated rings.
